build_system: pip for backend deps, npm for frontend. Backend uses uvicorn with --reload for dev. Frontend uses Vite dev server.
test_framework: pytest in backend/tests/. Fixtures use SQLite in-memory DB. Frontend uses TypeScript compiler (tsc --noEmit) for type checking.
build_command: Backend: uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 (from backend/). Frontend: npm run dev (from frontend/web/)
test_command: Backend: pytest tests -q (from backend/). Frontend: cd frontend/web && npx tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend: cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000. 2. Check http://localhost:8000/docs shows new /api/v1/tts/* endpoints. 3. Start frontend: cd frontend/web && npm run dev. 4. Open http://localhost:5173, log in, generate outfits, click speaker icon. 5. Run pytest tests -q from backend/
environment_constraints: Backend runs on port 8000, frontend web on 5173. CORS origins already configured for localhost:5173. Postgres in Docker on 5432. Storage uses LOCAL_STORAGE_DIR for dev. French is the UI language and TTS language.
contribution_requirements: Add Alembic migration for any DB schema changes (none needed here). Keep routes thin, logic in services/agents. Match existing code style. Test with pytest. Use absolute paths with e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main prefix.
key_patterns: Services in backend/app/services/ follow StorageService pattern: class with is_configured() method, lru_cache for expensive resources. Routes in backend/app/api/routes/ are thin, import from services/agents. Config in backend/app/core/config.py uses pydantic-settings with .env file. Frontend API calls via src/api.ts. React components in src/ (flat, not nested). French UI text throughout.
directory_structure: backend/app/services/ (business logic), backend/app/api/routes/ (REST endpoints), backend/app/core/config.py (settings), backend/tests/ (pytest tests), frontend/web/src/ (React components and API client). Agents in backend/app/agents/ but TTS is a service not an agent.
